PRE-01.note: App title at the top, left-justified

PRE-02.note: Fields use placeholders only ('Email'/'Password'); label disappears on typing — no persistent label

PRE-05.note: No fixed labels, hence no ':' or entry-invitation element

PRE-13.note: Missing essential guidance: no 'forgot password', no 'create account' — user has no recovery route

PRE-14.note: Error is inline text; no Help button/affordance

PRE-17.note: Generic failure message gives no diagnosis nor path to a solution

AGL-01.note: Card groups title/error/fields/button into a single clear functional zone

AGL-02.note: Logical order: title → subtitle → error → email → password → button

AGL-03.note: Inputs grouped together, action button below

AGL-10.note: Single button placed in a row below its associated fields

AGL-11.note: Single button = default action in the expected position (below)

AGF-01.note: Filled primary button stands out from text and inputs

AGF-03.note: Bold title, bordered inputs, colored button — distinct types

AGF-04.note: No label separate from the data; placeholder shares the same field/style as the value

AGF-06.note: Error message in red with a highlighted background

AGF-09.note: Inputs have no styled focus state (active field not highlighted)

AGF-11.note: Both fields are required but there is no visual indication of requiredness

AGF-13.note: Error shown in a distinctly styled box (color + background + radius)

AGF-16.note: The card acts as a grouping box for the related data

AGF-17.note: Button gets disabled during loading but with no visual change (opacity/color) — unavailable state not differentiated

FBK-01.note: Button spinner + error messages cover the main actions

FBK-02.note: During the request, no state/duration of unavailability is shown beyond the spinner

FBK-06.note: No duration indication for the login network call

FBK-07.note: Failure → error message; success → screen transition

FBK-09.note: No autoFocus: focus does not land on the first field when the screen opens

FBK-11.note: Button switches to a loading indicator — visible state change

LEG-01.note: Margins separate title, error, fields and button

LEG-08.note: Bold restricted to title and button

LEG-20.note: Placeholders 'Email'/'Password' start with a capital letter

CON-01.note: No default value (e.g. remembered email) to speed up entry

CON-10.note: Email is not normalized (lower-cased) on the client; upper/lower not treated as equivalent

CON-14.note: No 'remember email' / reuse of previous entries

AMI-01.note: Cursor is not auto-positioned in the first field (no autoFocus)

AMI-02.note: email→password→button ordering minimizes movement; return key configured

AMI-03.note: Return key 'next' on email does not move focus to password (no chained ref)

AMI-04.note: Single button acts as the default (submit triggers login)

DEN-04.note: Single screen; no need to remember data from another screen

AEX-01.note: Processes only on explicit button/submit action

AEX-03.note: Requires an explicit action (button or keyboard 'done')

AEX-04.note: Navigation between fields is commanded by the user

CTL-04.note: During loading there is no option to cancel/interrupt the in-flight login request

EXP-01.note: No affordances for experienced users (biometrics/saved login) nor assistance for novices beyond the basics

PRO-01.note: Validates empty fields before submit; email keyboard reduces typing errors

MSG-01.note: Failure message is generic — does not indicate cause nor how to fix

COR-01.note: Fields remain filled after an error; user can edit and retry easily

CST-01.note: Identical input styles; consistent visual pattern on the screen

CMP-01.note: Familiar login pattern; email keyboard and secure entry match expectations
